params.name: parentElemName
params.description: Receives the name of the parent element

params.name: parentElemValue
params.description: Receives the value of the parent element

overloads.semanticRole: Returns a reference to the parent XML element (or the "#document" reference if elementRef is a root element), optionally filling in the parent's name and value.

constraints: If elementRef is already the document node, the command returns a null reference ("0000000000000000") and sets OK to 0.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close
